# API map

> Generated by `composer docs` from `src/` and `config/qr-code.php`. Do not edit by hand.

Every public class, method, enum case and config key that is covered by semver. Anything tagged `@internal` is left out on purpose (see [Public API and `@internal`](reference.md#public-api-and-internal)). Methods inherited from Filament (`make()`, `label()`, `statePath()`, …) are not repeated. Guides: [README](../README.md) · [AI guide](ai.md).

Artisan commands: `php artisan qr-code:doctor` (environment checks), `php artisan make:qr-scan-field {name}` (scaffolds a `QrScanner` subclass).

## Plugin

### `FilamentQrCodePlugin`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\FilamentQrCodePlugin`

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `static get(): static` | The plugin instance registered on the current panel. |
| `static make(): static` | Create the plugin for `$panel->plugin()`. |

## Scanning components

### `QrScanner`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Forms\Components\QrScanner`

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `allowUpload(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Show the image-upload fallback in the camera modal. |
| `announceScan(string $code, bool $accepted, ?string $reason = null, ?string $field = null): ?string` | The custom announcement for a scan, or null for the built-in text. Called by the field JS when announceUsing() is set. |
| `announceUsing(?Closure $callback): static` | Custom announcement text: fn (string $code, bool $accepted, ?string $reason, string $field): ?string. Return null to keep the built-in text. |
| `announcements(Closure\|bool $enabled = true): static` | Read accepted and rejected scans aloud through the polite live region (on by default). |
| `beep(Closure\|bool\|null $success = null, Closure\|bool\|null $error = null): static` | Beep on accepted / rejected scans of server-checked fields; null keeps the config default. |
| `beepDuration(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Beep length in milliseconds (config `feedback.beep_duration_ms`). |
| `beepFrequency(Closure\|int $hertz): static` | Beep pitch in hertz (config `feedback.beep_frequency`). |
| `cameraControls(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Torch and zoom controls appear when the running camera supports them; pass false to keep the viewfinder free of them. |
| `clearOnReject(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Clear the field when a live scan is rejected (config `scan.clear_on_reject`). |
| `continuousDisplay(ContinuousDisplay\|Closure $display): static` | What a continuous field shows after an accepted scan: empty or the last code. |
| `cooldown(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Ignore the same code scanned again within this many milliseconds. |
| `flash(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Flash the field green / red on accepted / rejected scans of server-checked fields. |
| `formatScannedValue(string $rawValue): mixed` | Run the scanFormat() closure on a value (programmatic only; live scans use normalizeUsing()). |
| `formats(Closure\|array $formats): static` | Symbologies the camera decodes (BarcodeFormat cases or strings); filtering speeds decoding. |
| `fps(Closure\|int $fps): static` | Camera decode attempts per second (config `camera.fps`); setting it turns off the automatic slow-device degrade. |
| `handleScan(string $code, string $source): array` | Run the server checks for a scan; called by the field JS, usable from tests. |
| `hardwareInput(HardwareInputScope\|Closure $scope = HardwareInputScope::Focus, Closure\|bool $enabled = true): static` | Focus: wedge scans reach this field only while it has focus (default). Page: the field also catches wedge scans when no scan field has focus. |
| `hardwareScanner(Closure\|bool $enabled = true, Closure\|int $burstThresholdMs = 50, Closure\|bool $preventFormSubmit = true, Closure\|array $terminators = ['Enter', 'Tab'], Closure\|int $minBarcodeLength = 2, Closure\|int $scanTimeoutMs = 150, Closure\|int\|null $minFastKeys = null): static` | Tune the keyboard-wedge interceptor in one call (config `hardware_scanner.*`). |
| `keepCameraOpen(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Continuous mode: keep the camera running between scans. |
| `lookup(Closure\|string $model, Closure\|string $column = 'code', ?Closure $modifyQueryUsing = null): static` | Find a model by the scanned code; the scan is rejected when none matches. |
| `lookupUsing(?Closure $resolver, bool $fallback = false): static` | Find the record yourself (an API, a composite key, a non-Eloquent store). Replaces lookup() on this field unless $fallback, when it runs only after the model lookup found nothing. Return null or false for "not found". |
| `minFastKeys(Closure\|int $count): static` | Consecutive fast keystroke gaps required before a terminator counts as a scan (config `hardware_scanner.min_fast_keys`). |
| `mode(ScanMode\|Closure $mode): static` | Single (default) or continuous scanning for this field. |
| `nextField(Closure\|string\|null $fieldName): static` | Move focus to this field after a successful scan. |
| `normalizeScannedCode(string $code): string` | The code every check sees: the normalizeWith() presets (or a trim), then the normalizeUsing() closure. |
| `normalizeUsing(Closure $normalizer): static` | Live-scan normalizer (runs on every Livewire state update, including camera and hardware scans). Shorthand for afterStateUpdated() so the live hook is discoverable next to the programmatic-only scanFormat(). |
| `normalizeWith(bool $trim = true, bool $uppercase = false, array\|string\|null $stripPrefix = null): static` | Clean every scanned code in the browser (before duplicate detection and step matching) and again on the server. |
| `onRejected(?Closure $callback): static` | Callback run on a rejected server-checked scan (injects $code, $record, $source, $result). |
| `onScan(?Closure $callback): static` | Programmatic-only callback. Invoke via triggerOnScan() in custom flows — live scans dispatch the `qr-scanned` window event and update Livewire state directly instead. |
| `onScanned(?Closure $callback): static` | Callback run on an accepted server-checked scan (injects $code, $record, $source, $result). |
| `pauseOnReject(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Continuous mode: pause until the error is dismissed instead of scanning on. |
| `pipe(ScanCheckStage\|string ...$stages): static` | Add custom checks that run after the rules, lookup and closures. |
| `preferRearCamera(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Pick the rear camera first when no choice is remembered (config `camera.prefer_rear_camera`). |
| `qrbox(Closure\|int $qrbox): static` | Maximum decode-box edge in pixels; the real box scales to the viewfinder (config `camera.qrbox`). |
| `rejectWhen(Closure $predicate, Closure\|string $message): static` | Immediately reject a live scan matching $predicate: the state is cleared and a `qr-scan-rejected` browser event (with message) is dispatched so the app can notify the operator. |
| `runScanChecks(string $code, ?ScanInput $source): ScanResult` | Run the field's live-scan checks (rules, lookup, closures, piped stages) on an already normalized code. The first failure stops the run. |
| `static sanitizeScannedValue(string $value): string` | Strip handheld-scanner framing (STX/ETX prefixes, CR/LF suffixes) and surrounding whitespace. Mirrors the JS sanitizeScannedValue(). |
| `scanFormat(?Closure $formatter): static` | Programmatic-only formatter. Runs only via formatScannedValue() in custom flows — never on live camera/hardware scans. For live values use normalizeUsing() (or afterStateUpdated() directly). |
| `scanRules(Closure\|array $rules): static` | Submit-time validation rules for scanned values. Live scans write state directly, so these run on submit like any other field rules — pair with rejectWhen() for immediate feedback. |
| `scanTimeout(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Flush window in milliseconds for guns that send no terminator; 0 disables (config `hardware_scanner.scan_timeout_ms`). |
| `sound(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Play the synthesized beep on a successful scan (config `feedback.sound`). |
| `syncOptions(OptionsSync\|Closure\|string\|null $sync): static` | Morph (default): option changes reach the browser on every Livewire re-render. Refresh: only on a qr-scanner-refresh / qr-sequence-refresh event. |
| `triggerOnScan(string $scannedValue): void` | Run the onScan() closure and fire QrCodeScanned (programmatic only). |
| `validateUsing(ValidationRule\|Closure\|array $rules): static` | Laravel rules or a closure each live scan must pass on the server. |
| `vibrate(Closure\|bool $condition = true, ?array $success = null, ?array $error = null): static` | Vibrate on a successful scan; success / error patterns apply to server-checked fields. |
| `vibrateDuration(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Haptic pulse length in milliseconds (config `feedback.vibrate_duration_ms`). |

Getters (read the resolved option; used by the views): `getBeepDurationMs()`, `getBeepFrequencyHz()`, `getBurstThresholdMs()`, `getCameraScanPayload()`, `getCodeNormalizationScanPayload()`, `getCodeNormalizer()`, `getComponentScanPayload()`, `getContinuousDisplay()`, `getCooldownMs()`, `getEffectiveFps()`, `getErrorFeedback()`, `getFeedbackScanPayload()`, `getFps()`, `getHardwareInputScope()`, `getHardwareScannerScanPayload()`, `getMinBarcodeLength()`, `getMinFastKeys()`, `getMode()`, `getNextField()`, `getOptionsSync()`, `getOptionsSyncScanPayload()`, `getOutcomeFeedbackScanPayload()`, `getQrbox()`, `getRenderHookScopes()`, `getScanCheckPipeline()`, `getScanChecksScanPayload()`, `getScanModeScanPayload()`, `getScanPayload()`, `getScanTimeoutMs()`, `getSequentialScanPayload()`, `getSuccessFeedback()`, `getSupportedFormats()`, `getTerminators()`, `getVibrateDurationMs()`, `hasAnnouncements()`, `hasCameraControls()`, `hasServerScanChecks()`, `hasSound()`, `hasVibration()`, `isContinuous()`, `isHardwareScannerEnabled()`, `isPreferRearCamera()`, `isUploadAllowed()`, `shouldClearOnReject()`, `shouldKeepCameraOpen()`, `shouldPauseOnReject()`, `shouldPreventFormSubmit()`, `shouldWarnUnrestrictedPerformance()`

### `QrHardwareScannerListener`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Forms\Components\QrHardwareScannerListener`

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `autoFocusNext(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Focus the next registered field after each routed scan. |
| `beepDuration(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Beep length in milliseconds (config `feedback.beep_duration_ms`). |
| `beepFrequency(Closure\|int $hertz): static` | Beep pitch in hertz (config `feedback.beep_frequency`). |
| `fallbackToAnyInput(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Fill the first empty form input when no registered field is free; false dispatches `qr-scan-unrouted` (config `hardware_scanner.fallback_to_any_input`). |
| `fields(Closure\|array $fields): static` | Field names (dot paths allowed) the listener routes scans into. |
| `hardwareScanner(Closure\|bool $enabled = true, Closure\|int $burstThresholdMs = 50, Closure\|bool $preventFormSubmit = true, Closure\|array $terminators = ['Enter', 'Tab'], Closure\|int $minBarcodeLength = 2, Closure\|int $scanTimeoutMs = 150, Closure\|int\|null $minFastKeys = null): static` | Tune the keyboard-wedge interceptor in one call (config `hardware_scanner.*`). |
| `static make(Closure\|array $fields = []): static` | Create a Station Listener routing gun scans into these fields. |
| `minFastKeys(Closure\|int $count): static` | Consecutive fast keystroke gaps required before a terminator counts as a scan (config `hardware_scanner.min_fast_keys`). |
| `static sanitizeScannedValue(string $value): string` | Strip handheld-scanner framing (STX/ETX prefixes, CR/LF suffixes) and surrounding whitespace. Mirrors the JS sanitizeScannedValue(). |
| `scanTimeout(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Flush window in milliseconds for guns that send no terminator; 0 disables (config `hardware_scanner.scan_timeout_ms`). |
| `sound(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Play the synthesized beep on a successful scan (config `feedback.sound`). |
| `vibrate(Closure\|bool $condition = true, ?array $success = null, ?array $error = null): static` | Vibrate on a successful scan; success / error patterns apply to server-checked fields. |
| `vibrateDuration(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Haptic pulse length in milliseconds (config `feedback.vibrate_duration_ms`). |

Getters (read the resolved option; used by the views): `getBeepDurationMs()`, `getBeepFrequencyHz()`, `getBurstThresholdMs()`, `getComponentScanPayload()`, `getFeedbackScanPayload()`, `getFields()`, `getHardwareScannerScanPayload()`, `getMinBarcodeLength()`, `getMinFastKeys()`, `getScanPayload()`, `getScanTimeoutMs()`, `getTerminators()`, `getVibrateDurationMs()`, `hasSound()`, `hasVibration()`, `isAutoFocusNext()`, `isHardwareScannerEnabled()`, `shouldFallbackToAnyInput()`, `shouldPreventFormSubmit()`

### `QrScanSequence`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Forms\Components\QrScanSequence`

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `announceScan(string $code, bool $accepted, ?string $reason = null, ?string $field = null): ?string` | The custom announcement for a scan, or null for the built-in text. Called by the field JS when announceUsing() is set. |
| `announceUsing(?Closure $callback): static` | Custom announcement text: fn (string $code, bool $accepted, ?string $reason, string $field): ?string. Return null to keep the built-in text. |
| `announcements(Closure\|bool $enabled = true): static` | Read accepted and rejected scans aloud through the polite live region (on by default). |
| `autoSubmit(Closure\|bool\|null $condition = true, Closure\|string\|null $method = null): static` | Call the Livewire submit method once the sequence completes. |
| `beepDuration(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Beep length in milliseconds (config `feedback.beep_duration_ms`). |
| `beepFrequency(Closure\|int $hertz): static` | Beep pitch in hertz (config `feedback.beep_frequency`). |
| `cameraControls(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Torch and zoom controls appear when the running camera supports them; pass false to keep the viewfinder free of them. |
| `continuous(Closure\|bool\|null $condition = true): static` | Start over after every completed sequence, ready for the next item. |
| `editable(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Allow operators to correct a captured value inline (unedited vs edited modes). |
| `fields(Closure\|array $fields): static` | Field keys the sequence fills, in order. |
| `formatScannedValue(string $rawValue): mixed` | Run the scanFormat() closure on a value (programmatic only; live scans use normalizeStepUsing()). |
| `formats(Closure\|array $formats): static` | Symbologies the camera decodes (BarcodeFormat cases or strings); filtering speeds decoding. |
| `fps(Closure\|int $fps): static` | Camera decode attempts per second (config `camera.fps`); setting it turns off the automatic slow-device degrade. |
| `getFinishCode(ScanStep $step): ?string` | Resolved finish code for a step. |
| `getMissingSequenceKeys(?array $mergedState = null): array` | Required step keys that still have no value. |
| `getRepeatComplete(ScanStep $step): RepeatComplete` | Resolved repeat-complete behaviour for a step. |
| `getRepeatCountOverride(string $step): ?int` | Repeat count set at runtime with setRepeatCount(), if any. |
| `getRepeatLimit(ScanStep $step, array $values): ?int` | Resolved repeat(n) count for a step. |
| `getStepValuePath(string $key): string` | Where each step's value lives in Livewire state: the component's own state path when it has one, else the flat per-step path. |
| `goToStep(string $step): void` | Move the browser to a step (page code). |
| `handleStepScan(string $step, string $code, string $source): array` | Run the server checks for one step scan; called by the sequence JS, usable from tests. |
| `hardwareScanner(Closure\|bool $enabled = true, Closure\|int $burstThresholdMs = 50, Closure\|bool $preventFormSubmit = true, Closure\|array $terminators = ['Enter', 'Tab'], Closure\|int $minBarcodeLength = 2, Closure\|int $scanTimeoutMs = 150, Closure\|int\|null $minFastKeys = null): static` | Tune the keyboard-wedge interceptor in one call (config `hardware_scanner.*`). |
| `isSequenceComplete(?array $mergedState = null): bool` | Whether every required step has a value. |
| `isStepActive(ScanStep $step, array $values): bool` | A step is active unless its when() condition returns false. A condition that throws counts as active, so a broken closure never hides a step. |
| `isStepFilled(ScanStep $step, array $values): bool` | A repeat step is filled with its count of codes, or one code when open-ended. |
| `static make(Closure\|array $fields = []): static` | Create a sequence over these field keys (or ScanStep objects). |
| `mergeSequenceState(array $formState): array` | Merge sequence values into a form state array so callers no longer hand-roll array_merge($this->data, $this->form->getState()). |
| `minFastKeys(Closure\|int $count): static` | Consecutive fast keystroke gaps required before a terminator counts as a scan (config `hardware_scanner.min_fast_keys`). |
| `normalizeStepUsing(?Closure $normalizer): static` | Live-step normalizer, applied by getSequenceState() and mergeSequenceState() (e.g. strtoupper(trim($value))). This is the live-scan counterpart to the programmatic-only scanFormat(). |
| `normalizeWith(bool $trim = true, bool $uppercase = false, array\|string\|null $stripPrefix = null): static` | Clean every scanned code in the browser (before duplicate detection and step matching) and again on the server. |
| `onCompleted(?Closure $callback): static` | Callback run with every step value once the whole sequence is complete. |
| `onInvalidSequence(InvalidSequenceBehavior\|Closure\|null $behavior): static` | What a failed validateAllUsing() check does: jump back to the failing step or restart. |
| `onStepAccepted(?Closure $callback): static` | Side effect after a step accepts a live scan (log, notify). Receives $step, $result, $code, $record, $values; its return value is ignored. |
| `onStepRejected(?Closure $callback): static` | Side effect after a step rejects a scan. It can't change the result or the message. |
| `onStepScanned(?Closure $callback): static` | Programmatic-only step callback. Invoke via triggerOnStep() in custom flows — live scans dispatch the `qr-sequence-step` window event and write Livewire state directly instead. |
| `preferRearCamera(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Pick the rear camera first when no choice is remembered (config `camera.prefer_rear_camera`). |
| `qrbox(Closure\|int $qrbox): static` | Maximum decode-box edge in pixels; the real box scales to the viewfinder (config `camera.qrbox`). |
| `resetAfterSubmit(Closure\|bool\|null $condition = true): static` | Clear the non-sticky steps after a successful submit. |
| `resetSequence(bool $keepSticky = true, array $values = []): void` | Start the sequence over from page code: sticky values stay unless $keepSticky is false; $values seeds steps. |
| `static sanitizeScannedValue(string $value): string` | Strip handheld-scanner framing (STX/ETX prefixes, CR/LF suffixes) and surrounding whitespace. Mirrors the JS sanitizeScannedValue(). |
| `scanFormat(?Closure $formatter): static` | Programmatic-only step formatter. Runs via formatScannedValue() / triggerOnStep() in custom flows — never on live camera/hardware scans. For live values use normalizeStepUsing() (applied on merge) or afterStateUpdated() on real fields. |
| `scanTimeout(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Flush window in milliseconds for guns that send no terminator; 0 disables (config `hardware_scanner.scan_timeout_ms`). |
| `setRepeatCount(string $step, ?int $count): void` | Override a repeat step's count for this page until set back to null. Stored in the session so later server checks agree with the browser. |
| `sound(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Play the synthesized beep on a successful scan (config `feedback.sound`). |
| `steps(Closure\|array $steps): static` | ScanStep definitions, in order (replaces fields()). |
| `syncOptions(OptionsSync\|Closure\|string\|null $sync): static` | Morph (default): option changes reach the browser on every Livewire re-render. Refresh: only on a qr-scanner-refresh / qr-sequence-refresh event. |
| `triggerOnStep(string $fieldKey, string $scannedValue): void` | Run the onStepScanned() closure for a step (programmatic only). |
| `validateAllUsing(Closure\|array\|null $rules): static` | Check the whole set once every required step has a value. Rules are keyed by step; unkeyed rules apply to the last step. A closure receives $values and returns null or [] to pass, a message (last step) or [step => message]. |
| `vibrate(Closure\|bool $condition = true, ?array $success = null, ?array $error = null): static` | Vibrate on a successful scan; success / error patterns apply to server-checked fields. |
| `vibrateDuration(Closure\|int $milliseconds): static` | Haptic pulse length in milliseconds (config `feedback.vibrate_duration_ms`). |

Getters (read the resolved option; used by the views): `getAutoSubmitMethod()`, `getAutomaticKey()`, `getBeepDurationMs()`, `getBeepFrequencyHz()`, `getBurstThresholdMs()`, `getCameraScanPayload()`, `getCodeNormalizationScanPayload()`, `getCodeNormalizer()`, `getComponentScanPayload()`, `getComponentStatePath()`, `getControlKey()`, `getEffectiveFps()`, `getFeedbackScanPayload()`, `getFlatStatePrefix()`, `getFps()`, `getHardwareScannerScanPayload()`, `getInvalidSequenceBehavior()`, `getMinBarcodeLength()`, `getMinFastKeys()`, `getOptionsSync()`, `getOptionsSyncScanPayload()`, `getQrbox()`, `getRenderHookScopes()`, `getScanFields()`, `getScanPayload()`, `getScanSteps()`, `getScanTimeoutMs()`, `getSequenceState()`, `getStepsPayload()`, `getSupportedFormats()`, `getTerminators()`, `getVibrateDurationMs()`, `hasAnnouncements()`, `hasCameraControls()`, `hasServerSequenceWork()`, `hasSound()`, `hasVibration()`, `isContinuous()`, `isEditable()`, `isHardwareScannerEnabled()`, `isPreferRearCamera()`, `shouldAutoSubmit()`, `shouldPreventFormSubmit()`, `shouldResetAfterSubmit()`, `shouldWarnUnrestrictedPerformance()`

### `ScanStep`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Support\ScanStep` — One step of a QrScanSequence: a state key, a label and the checks a scanned code must pass (rules, then a lookup, then closures).

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `allowDuplicates(Closure\|bool $condition = true): ScanStep` | Accept the same code more than once in a repeat step. |
| `finishWith(Closure\|string\|null $code): ScanStep` | A scan that finishes this repeat step instead of being stored. |
| `static fromField(string\|int $index, mixed $field): ?ScanStep` | Adapter for the legacy fields() shapes: 'key', 'key' => 'Label' and ['key' => ..., 'label' => ...]. |
| `label(Closure\|string\|null $label): ScanStep` | Step label shown in the progress list. |
| `lookup(Closure\|string $model, Closure\|string $column = 'code', ?Closure $modifyQueryUsing = null): ScanStep` | Find a model by the scanned code; the scan is rejected when none matches. |
| `lookupUsing(?Closure $resolver, bool $fallback = false): ScanStep` | Find the step's record yourself. Replaces lookup() unless $fallback, when it runs only after the model lookup found nothing. |
| `static make(string $key): ScanStep` | Create a sequence step bound to a field key. |
| `normalizeUsing(?Closure $normalizer): ScanStep` | Clean this step's codes before its checks (after the sequence's own normalizers). |
| `onRepeatComplete(RepeatComplete\|Closure\|null $behavior): ScanStep` | What a full repeat(n) step does next: advance or wait for a finish scan. |
| `optional(Closure\|bool $condition = true): ScanStep` | Allow the sequence to complete without this step. |
| `pipe(ScanCheckStage\|string ...$stages): ScanStep` | Custom checks that run after the rules, lookup and closures. |
| `repeat(Closure\|int\|null $times = null): ScanStep` | Collect several codes into a list. With a count (or a closure receiving $values) the step fills up; without one it stays open until finished. |
| `sticky(Closure\|bool $condition = true): ScanStep` | Keep the value across resetAfterSubmit(), continuous() and Restart rounds. |
| `toField(): array` | The step as a plain array for the browser. |
| `validateUsing(ValidationRule\|Closure\|array $rules): ScanStep` | Laravel rules or a closure each scan for this step must pass. |
| `when(?Closure $condition): ScanStep` | Make the step conditional. The sequence evaluates the closure with $values and $step; while it returns false the step is skipped, not required, and its value is dropped. |

Getters (read the resolved option; used by the views): `allowsDuplicates()`, `getFinishCodeUsing()`, `getKey()`, `getLabel()`, `getNormalizeUsing()`, `getRepeatCompleteUsing()`, `getRepeatTimesUsing()`, `getWhenUsing()`, `hasChecks()`, `isOptional()`, `isRepeating()`, `isSticky()`

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `getDownloadSpec(mixed $record = null): QrRenderSpec` | One render spec for every download, so single and bulk exports can never diverge in options again. Defaults preserve the historic black-on-white output; callers opt into colors, logo, and caption. |
| `qrBackgroundColor(Closure\|string $hexColor): static` | Background colour as hex. |
| `qrCaption(Closure\|string\|null $text): static` | Caption text under the QR (forces PNG). |
| `qrColor(Closure\|string $hexColor): static` | Foreground colour as hex. |
| `qrData(Closure\|string\|null $data): static` | Value to encode; a closure receives the record. |
| `qrErrorCorrection(Closure\|string\|null $level): static` | Error-correction level: L, M, Q or H. |
| `qrFileName(Closure\|string\|null $name): static` | Download file name without extension. |
| `qrFormat(QrFormat\|Closure\|string $format): static` | Output format of the downloaded file (SVG or PNG). |
| `qrImageSize(Closure\|int $size): static` | Downloaded image size in pixels. |
| `qrLogo(Closure\|string\|null $path, Closure\|int $size = 50): static` | Embed a logo image in the centre (forces PNG). |
| `qrMargin(Closure\|int $margin): static` | Quiet-zone margin in modules. |
| `recordsToFiles(Collection $records): array` | Render each record's QR code with this action's settings. Records with empty data are skipped. |
| `zipName(Closure\|string $name): static` | Attribute name (or closure receiving the record) resolving each row's encoded value. |

## Services and helpers

### `FilamentQrCode`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Facades\FilamentQrCode`


### `QrCodeService`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Services\QrCodeService` — Fluent facade over the rendering pipeline (QrRenderer, QrRenderCache, compositors). Holds configuration only; rendering lives in the Rendering namespace.

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `__construct()` | Create a renderer seeded with the `generator` config defaults. |
| `backgroundColor(string $hexColor): QrCodeService` | Background colour as hex. |
| `static cacheStore(?string $store): void` | Laravel cache store for the persistent render cache; null uses the default store. |
| `static cacheTtl(int\|false\|null $seconds): void` | Override generator.cache_ttl at runtime: seconds to keep persistent (L2) entries, false to turn the L2 cache off, null to clear the override and use the config again. |
| `color(string $hexColor): QrCodeService` | Foreground colour as hex. |
| `download(?string $fileName = null): StreamedResponse` | Render the QR as a download response. |
| `static effectiveCacheTtl(): int\|false\|null` | The persistent (L2) cache TTL in effect: the cacheTtl() override, else generator.cache_ttl. An int is seconds, null means no expiry, and false means the L2 cache is off (the in-process cache still works). |
| `errorCorrection(ErrorCorrectionLevel\|string $level): QrCodeService` | Error-correction level: L, M, Q or H. |
| `fileName(string $fileName): QrCodeService` | File name used by download() and stream(). |
| `static flushPersistentCache(): void` | Clear the persistent (Laravel cache) render cache. |
| `static flushRenderCache(): void` | Clear the in-process render cache. |
| `font(string $fontPath): QrCodeService` | TrueType font file for withText() overlays. |
| `format(QrFormat\|string $format): QrCodeService` | Output SVG or PNG. |
| `generate(string $data): QrCodeService` | Render the QR and return the raw SVG or PNG bytes. |
| `logo(string $path, int $size = 50): QrCodeService` | Embed a logo image in the centre (forces PNG). |
| `static make(): QrCodeService` | Start a fresh render (same as the `FilamentQrCode` facade). |
| `margin(int $margin): QrCodeService` | Quiet-zone margin in modules. |
| `static persistentCache(bool $enabled = true): void` | Toggle the persistent (Laravel Cache) L2 layer. The in-process L1 stays active regardless so repeated renders in one request encode once. |
| `size(int $size): QrCodeService` | Image size in pixels. |
| `stream(?string $fileName = null): StreamedResponse` | Render the QR as an inline image response. |
| `toDataUri(): string` | Render the QR as a `data:` URI for `<img src>`. |
| `withText(string $text, int $fontSize = 16, string $fontColor = '#000000', ?string $fontPath = null): QrCodeService` | Text overlay under the QR (forces PNG; falls back to GD bitmap fonts). |

Getters (read the resolved option; used by the views): `getRaw()`

### `QrPayload`

`Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Support\QrPayload` — Typed builders for common QR payload formats (WiFi, vCard, geo, …) so apps stop hand-concatenating escaping-sensitive strings.

| Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `static geo(float $latitude, float $longitude, ?string $query = null): string` | geo: payload from latitude and longitude. |
| `static mailto(string $to, ?string $subject = null, ?string $body = null): string` | mailto: payload with optional subject and body. |
| `static sms(string $number, ?string $body = null): string` | SMSTO: payload with an optional message. |
| `static url(string $url): string` | URL payload. |
| `static vcard(array $contact): string` | Escaped vCard 3.0 payload from name, phone, email, … keys. |
| `static wifi(string $ssid, ?string $password = null, string $encryption = 'WPA', bool $hidden = false): string` | Escaped Wi-Fi join payload (`WIFI:`). |

<!-- file: UPGRADE.md -->

# Upgrade guide

## From 1.0.0 to 1.0.1

1.0.1 drops Laravel 11. Upgrade your app to Laravel 12 or 13 first; Laravel 11 apps stay on 1.0.0 (Composer keeps resolving 1.0.0 for them).

Otherwise nothing to change: 1.0.1 only adds opt-in keys (`generator.logo_base_paths`, `image_route.ttl`, `image_route.throttle`, `image_route.strict_colors`). If you published `config/qr-code.php`, copy the new keys from the package config when you want them — see [Image route security](docs/generating.md#image-route-security).

One behaviour fix: the image route now answers invalid input (missing `data`, out-of-range `size`, unknown `format` or `ec`, unparseable colours like `red`) with 422 instead of a 302 redirect or, for colours, a 500. If you assert on those responses, expect 422.

## From 0.6 to 1.0

1.0 removes everything 0.5 and 0.6 deprecated and changes one default. Search your app for each name below; most apps only need steps 1 and 2.

### 1. Rebuild the assets

```bash
composer update mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code
php artisan filament:assets
```

### 2. `min_fast_keys` now defaults to 3

A keyboard-wedge burst now needs three consecutive fast keystrokes before a terminator counts as a scan (it was 1). This keeps fast human typing from being taken for a scan. Every handheld gun we know of types much faster than that. If a slow or Bluetooth gun's short codes are missed, go back to the old value:

```php
// config/qr-code.php
'hardware_scanner' => [
    'min_fast_keys' => 1,
],

// or per component
QrScanner::make('sku')->minFastKeys(1);
```

The JS defaults (`createHardwareScannerHandler()`, `FilamentQrCode.router`) changed the same way.

### 3. Route name `filament-qr-code.image` is removed

Use `filamentQrCode.image`:

```php
// Before
URL::signedRoute('filament-qr-code.image', $parameters);

// After
URL::signedRoute('filamentQrCode.image', $parameters);
```

### 4. `suppressWhenGlobalListener()` and `isGlobalHardwareListenerActive()` are removed

The input router has given every burst exactly one owner since 0.5, so these did nothing. Delete the calls:

- `->suppressWhenGlobalListener(...)` and `isSuppressedWhenGlobalListenerActive()` on every scan surface;
- the `suppressWhenGlobalListenerActive:` argument of `hardwareScanner(...)` (if you passed `minFastKeys` positionally, it is now the 7th argument; use the named argument);
- `window.FilamentQrCode.isGlobalHardwareListenerActive()` in your JS;
- the `suppressWhenGlobalListenerActive` / `suppressWhenGlobal` payload keys, if you read them.

### 5. `QrScanSequence::statePathPrefix()` is removed

The flat per-step paths (`data.step`, `data.employee`, …) now always follow the schema's `statePath()`, so they can no longer point outside the form. Remove `->statePathPrefix(...)`; the "scans will be lost on submit" warning (`prefixMismatchWarning()`, `ui.sequence_prefix_mismatch`) is gone with it. If you set a prefix different from the schema `statePath()`, give the sequence its own `->statePath()` and read it with `mergeSequenceState()`.

### 6. `LogQrCodeScan` is now `LogQrCodeScanListener`

```php
// Before
use Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Listeners\LogQrCodeScan;

// After
use Mmuqiitf\FilamentQrCode\Listeners\LogQrCodeScanListener;
```

Only code that references the class (to unregister it, or in an `Event::fake()` assertion) needs the change; the package registers it for you.

### 7. `QrCodeDisplay::getQrSvgOrDataUri()` is removed

It returned the same value as `getQrDataUri()`. Rename the call, including in published `qr-code-display` views (`$getQrSvgOrDataUri()` becomes `$getQrDataUri()`):

```php
// Before
$uri = $display->getQrSvgOrDataUri();

// After
$uri = $display->getQrDataUri();
```

### 8. `QrCodeService` subclasses

Only if you extend `QrCodeService`: the protected `applyLogo()`, `applyTextOverlay()`, `readPersistentCache()` and `writePersistentCache()` methods and the protected static `$renderCache` property are gone, with no shims. Override `generate()` or wrap the service instead.

### `@internal` members

Some classes and methods are now tagged `@internal` (see [Public API and `@internal`](docs/reference.md#public-api-and-internal)). They still work, but they are no longer covered by semver. If you call one from app code, move to the documented API.

### `bacon/bacon-qr-code` 3.0.4 or newer

The package now requires `bacon/bacon-qr-code` `^3.0.4`. If your lock file has an older 3.0.x, `composer update mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code --with-dependencies` updates it.

### Behaviour changes

- An inline `QrCollector` now calls `handleCollectorScan($code)` on the host Livewire component when it defines that method, as documented. Before 1.0 it always dispatched the `qr-collector-item-added` window event instead. The event is no longer dispatched when the hook exists, so code that forwarded it to the same method is now dead; remove it.

- `generator.cache_ttl => false` now really turns the persistent render cache off. Before 1.0 it cached forever, like `null`. If you set `false` and relied on that, set `null` instead.

- `validateAllUsing()` now also runs when a counted step (`repeat(n)`) is finished early with `finishWith()`. A failing whole-set check reports its own message and jumps to (or restarts from) the invalid step, like a failed completion, instead of the generic "needs n codes" message. When the whole set passes, the count message stays.
- `->pipe()` stages (and every step check) see the same `$values` live and on submit: the active steps before the step, plus the codes scanned before this one in a repeat step. On submit they used to see the whole form.
- The camera stops while the page is hidden (a locked phone, a background tab) and starts again when the page is visible, unless the operator stopped it in between.
- The scanner modal's overlay is now positioned by the package stylesheet, so it covers the viewport even when the panel theme does not `@source` the package views.
- Camera errors are translated and no longer show the raw browser error text. If you published `ui.php`, add the new keys (`camera_*`, `announce_*`; see the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md)); missing keys fall back to the key name. `ui.loading_camera` is gone.
- The collector, collect-action modal and scan sequence announce accepted and rejected scans to screen readers. If you override the `qr-collector`, `qr-collector-modal` or `qr-scan-sequence` views, include `filament-qr-code::components.announcer`. The sequence rejection text is no longer `role="alert"`.

## From 0.5 to 0.6

Most apps only need the first two steps.

### 1. Rebuild the assets

```bash
composer update mmuqiitf/filament-qr-code
php artisan filament:assets
```

The scanner and sequence scripts changed (runtime control, the shared input router). Stale assets in `public/` keep the old behaviour.

### 2. Republish customised views

If you published the package views, republish them and re-apply your changes:

```bash
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=filament-qr-code-views --force
```

The views are now split into one file per part (`components/scanner/*`, `components/sequence/*`). The scanner's `x-data` no longer embeds the options (they're on `data-qr-options`), and the sequence has a new wrapper `<div data-qr-options>`. An old full-view override keeps the old markup and will miss runtime control.

Keep only the files you changed under `resources/views/vendor/filament-qr-code/components/`. Before reaching for a view, check whether `extraAttributes()`, the `--fi-qr-*` CSS variables or a `QrCodeRenderHook` covers it: those survive upgrades. See [the styling recipe](docs/recipes/styling.md).

### 3. `ScanResult::$record` can be any value

`$record` is now typed `mixed`: `lookupUsing()` may return an array, a DTO or a model. If your code reads `$result->record->getKey()`, use `$result->recordKey()`: the model key, else `id` or `key` from an array or object record:

```php
// Before
$id = $result->record?->getKey();

// After
$id = $result->recordKey();
```

Code that only uses `lookup(Model::class, ...)` still gets a model.

### 4. `normalizeUsing()` runs before the checks

A scanner's `normalizeUsing()` used to clean only the stored value. It now also runs on the server before the rules, the lookup and stages, so a lookup sees the normalized code. If you relied on the raw code in a rule, normalize inside the rule instead, or use `normalizeWith()` presets, which run identically in the browser and on the server.

### 5. Route name `filament-qr-code.image` is deprecated

The signed image route is `filamentQrCode.image`. The kebab-case `filament-qr-code.image` still generates the same URL but is a deprecated alias and will be removed in 1.0:

```php
// Before
URL::signedRoute('filament-qr-code.image', $parameters);

// After
URL::signedRoute('filamentQrCode.image', $parameters);
```

### Smaller changes

- An optional step whose check fails now also gives way to a following repeat step (`po, sku, lot?, serials` works). Workarounds that put the optional step last can go.
- Scanner options (`continuousDisplay()`, `pauseOnReject()`, `repeat()` counts, …) now follow the server on every re-render. Workarounds that re-mount the field with a changing `wire:key` can go.
- `QrScanSequence::make()` runs `setUp()` and `configureUsing()` callbacks; sequences with a state path fill to `[]`.
- `ScanAccepted` / `ScanRejected` / `ScanSequenceCompleted` gained optional fields (`statePath`, `livewireClass`, `livewireId`, `sequence`, `values`). Listeners that build these events themselves (tests) keep working: the new constructor arguments are optional.
